name: Ragnor Skybreaker
passives: Oathbound — Ragnor's Mastery: Ragnor's Storm Oath: a solo vow scar that grows when the Titan uses movement through storm lanes to control enemies instead of relying on allies. Counterplay remains: deny favored terrain, force reaction bait, drain Momentum or Divinity.
lore: Ragnor Skybreaker is a colossal Asgardian artillery from The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Titan is the older source: Asgardian artillery office: far-sight strike, horizon pressure, prophetic range; Jotnar: frost, mountain scale, primal opposition.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source Titan, not a costume: Ragnor Skybreaker shows storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow.. Role silhouette must read as Artillery. Materials include dark rune iron, storm steel, ash wood, wolf fur, raven feather shadow, oath red wax, bone white. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid cartoon Viking, generic horned helmet cosplay, clean chrome, sci-fi power armor, glowing UI runes, blocky hammer mech.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, named gear, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Ragnor Longshot Strike
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Storm damage at range 5; gain 8 Momentum, or 12 if used from storm-marked terrain or into the Titan's marked target.
abilityDetails.counterplay: Line-of-sight denial, evasion, armor, or forcing low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Thunder Zone Bombardment
abilityDetails.effect: Apply ranged area damage and objective-zone denial; also builds 10 Oathstorm when it changes enemy intent or breaks an objective action.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Ragnor Skybreaker: Horizon Cataclysm
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Oathstorm to create a two-round battlefield rule around storm-marked terrain; enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum, or trigger the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Thunder Storm Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: +15% damage, +12 mitigation, empowered Oathstorm, and one mythic reaction override. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Runebound Thunder Implement
equipmentDetails.effect: +5 attack. Empowered basics against vulnerable enemies generate +4 Momentum but cannot trigger more than once per round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action generation; damage bonus capped against bosses.

equipmentDetails.name: Ragnor Skybreaker Realmplate
equipmentDetails.effect: +1 armor and +1 resistance. First preventable hazard hit each battle is reduced by 25% if the Titan used a reaction last round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Hazard reduction does not prevent scripted boss mechanics.

equipmentDetails.name: Ragnor Oathstorm Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Oathstorm cap +20. At 80+ Oathstorm, the next Technique gains a role-specific rider, then drains 30 Oathstorm.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: One empowered Technique per two rounds; cannot chain with Ascension opener.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: project damage into crowds and objective zones
